move.title: Move Hermesh to the Applications folder?
move.body: Hermesh needs to be in the Applications folder to run in the background and keep itself up to date. It opens again from there.
move.failedTitle: Couldn’t move Hermesh to the Applications folder
move.failedBody: Drag Hermesh to the Applications folder in Finder, then open it from there.

signer.declined: Windows asked for permission to set up Hermesh’s signer, and it wasn’t given. Without it, this PC can’t keep your owner key.
signer.notAdmin: This PC can be a trusted device from an administrator account only. Join as a machine only, or approve on another of your devices.
signer.uacOff: User Account Control is off, so nothing keeps your programs from the key. Turn it on to make this PC a trusted device.
signer.noTPM: This PC has no TPM 2.0 to keep your owner key in.
signer.failed: Hermesh’s signer couldn’t be set up (error {{code}}).
signer.notRunning: Hermesh’s signer didn’t start. Try again.
